items.title: Axon Enterprise (AXON) Commits $1.2 Billion To A Public Safety Drone Deal
items.summary: Axon Enterprise (NasdaqGS:AXON) announced a US$1.2b investment in US drone maker Skydio to deepen their public safety partnership. The deal includes exclusive distribution rights for Skydio products to public safety and law enforcement customers through Axon's global network. Axon is set to increase its ownership stake in Skydio, tying the drone supplier more tightly into Axon's product ecosystem.
